title: Villager on a leash
description: Simply use a leash with a villager like with other mobs
body:
# 🧑‍🌾 Villager on a leash – Take Your Villagers for a Walk!
**SUPPORTING 1.12-latest!**

With Villager on a leash, you can finally do what vanilla Minecraft doesn’t allow: leash villagers just like animals! No more pushing or building elaborate rails.
Move your farmers, librarians, and traders with ease.

## 🔹 Features:
- Leash villagers with a lead, just like mobs
- Works with all villager types and professions
- Reload the config.yml file with 
```
/voal reloadconfig
```
- Leash wandering Traders when activated in config.yml -> [clean config.yml on wiki site](https://www.pitchi.de/projects/villager_on_a_leash.html)
- Custom crafting recipe when activated in config.yml -> [clean config.yml on wiki site](https://www.pitchi.de/projects/villager_on_a_leash.html)

Recipe for Villager leash:

![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e83b038ae18cf7f84fc4c6e50e96d1f05772949d.png)

## Technical Details (of the newest version)
- Buildversion: 1.18.2
- If you changed the config and try to reload in with PlugmanX it may not work. Use 
```
/voal reloadconfig
```
 instead!

## 📝 Notes
- It's not possible yet to leash villagers together with other villagers/mobs. This feature will come in v1.0 within the next days
